dialog.disclaimer: AI answers can be wrong. Review before running.
dialog.instructionPlaceholder: Describe what you want, e.g. orders per department last month (Ctrl+Enter to send)

comments.none: All comments on these tables are already filled in.

settings.unavailable: This server does not support AI.
settings.managedOn: AI is enabled by the administrator
settings.managedHint: The provider is configured by the administrator.
settings.enabledHint: When off, AI entries are hidden everywhere.
settings.commandHint: The question goes to the command's standard input and the answer is read from its standard output. The command runs in an empty temporary folder.
settings.baseUrlHint: Address of an OpenAI-compatible API (OpenAI, DeepSeek, Qwen, Ollama…), usually ending in /v1.
settings.baseUrlAnthropicHint: Leave empty for the official endpoint.
settings.keyHint: Stored in the system keychain or the local vault and never shown. Not needed for a local Ollama.
settings.keySaved: Saved (type a new one to replace)
settings.boundary: By default only the structure (table names, columns, types, comments, indexes) and your statements are sent to the provider, never data. Sample rows for comment inference must be enabled per connection in its advanced options. AI results are suggestions and never run automatically.

mcp.hint: Add this to your agent's MCP settings (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor…) to let it read structure and run read-only queries. Only connections with "Allow MCP access" in their advanced options are visible.
